title: Functions and Relationships: Tables, Formulae, Direct and Inverse Proportion
seo_title: Grade 9 Functions and Relationships Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Determine input values, output values or rules for patterns and relationships using flow diagrams, tables, formulae and equations; determine, interpret and justify equivalence of different descriptions of the same relationship or rule; describe direct and inverse proportion.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 9 functions worksheets: flow diagrams, tables of values, points on a line and direct and inverse proportion. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Direct: y = kx. Inverse: xy = k.
key_sub: Test the rule on every pair.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A function gives one output for each input.
  • Substitute the input into the formula to find the output.
  • Direct proportion: y = kx (the ratio y ÷ x stays the same).
  • Inverse proportion: y = kx (the product xy stays the same).

Examples

Example

y is inversely proportional to x; y = 6 when x = 4

k = 24

Answer: y = 3 when x = 8

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
One pair onlyTest the rule on every pair.
Negatives−3 × (−2) = 6.
Inverse as directMore workers: less time.
